name: Transitions Pro · 11 Effetti
summary: Transizioni cinematografiche tra Immagine Iniziale e Finale con gli 11 effetti Fuobe (Roll, Flame, Melt, Splash, Display, Jump...).

inputs.label: Stile Transizione Fuobe
inputs.default: The camera rolls forward like a spinning wheel, rotating through the frame to transition seamlessly from the start frame into the end frame

options.value: The camera rolls forward like a spinning wheel, rotating through the frame to transition seamlessly from the start frame into the end frame
options.label: Roll Transition

options.value: Vertical columns flip one after another across the frame, wiping from the start frame to the end frame
options.label: Column Wipe

options.value: The camera pushes into a screen in the start frame, and the display content becomes the end frame as it fills the view
options.label: Display Transition

options.value: Flames sweep across the frame and burn away the start frame, revealing the end frame beneath
options.label: Flame Transition

options.value: A hand swipes across the lens, covering the start frame, and pulls away to reveal the end frame
options.label: Hand Transition

options.value: A hole opens in the middle of the start frame and the camera dives through it into the end frame
options.label: Hole Transition

options.value: The subject jumps toward the camera and lands in the end frame's location, matched on the action
options.label: Jump Transition

options.value: The start frame melts and drips away like liquid, revealing the end frame underneath
options.label: Melt Transition

options.value: Thick smoke billows across the frame, swallowing the start frame, and clears on the end frame
options.label: Smoke Transition

options.value: A splash of water bursts across the lens, washing the start frame away and settling on the end frame
options.label: Splash Transition

options.value: A truck drives across the foreground, blocking the view, and when it passes the scene has become the end frame
options.label: Trucksition

bind.template: Smooth cinematic {transition} transition from the opening frame to the closing frame. {prompt}
